How to use Uplink Post Kit

Me, first: it is the publishing floor for Uplink. Public visitors can see the schedule and the posts; the editing functions need the private key.

Open Uplink Post Kit →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open uplink-posts.floot.app; the public link is view only.

2

Use the five views in the header: Posts, Yap, Live, Saves, Playbook.

3

In Posts, filter To post, To review, Posted or All, and open a card to see the slides or the video.

4

In Live, read a run of show to see how a faceless live session is prepared.

5

In Playbook, read the forty two moves distilled from saved videos.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01Posts

Posts

The queue: scheduled time, series, slides or video, status, platform buttons, and the posted tick.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Filter the queue
  2. Open a card
  3. Read caption and slides
  4. With the key: approve, request changes, post, mark posted
02Yap

Yap

Daily talking to camera scripts: hook, story, call to action.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Open the day
  2. Read the script
  3. Film it
  4. Mark it done
03Live

Live

Full run of show for faceless live sessions: before you go live, clock marks, what to say and do, pinned comment, after the live.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Pick the session
  2. Read the before list
  3. Follow the clock marks
  4. Do the after list
04Saves and Playbook

Saves and Playbook

Saved videos turned into lessons, ideas and a playbook of moves.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Browse the saves
  2. Read the lesson and the idea
  3. Open the playbook section
  4. Try one move this week
03Tips
  • One idea per post; a mixed list teaches nothing.
  • Review on the phone where you will post.
  • The posted tick is the only bookkeeping you need.
  • The playbook is the method; the posts are the output.
04FAQ
Can I use it for my brand?

Yes, as a service: the same system can be set up for you; see the services page.

Why is it view only?

The editing key stays private; the public link shows the schedule and the posts.

Where do posts go?

TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Facebook, through the phone's share sheet.

How many posts a day?

Up to twenty carousels and five videos, scheduled.
